en.moment_body: He came on with half an hour left and the game still level. In the 106th minute he found the roof of the net — and ran, not to the crowd, but to the bench. To the ones who had waited all tournament for a moment that might never arrive.
en.meta_title: Los Suplentes — Iconic Series T-Shirt | MOMUTO
en.meta_description: Premium heavyweight cotton tee. Los Suplentes, piece IM–07 of the MOMUTO Iconic Series: the substitute's winner in the 106th minute, drawn in expressive sketch illustration.
